conviction_note: Q3 should land at or above the top of the guide, as Q2 did. That is offset by a 47% rally off the 28 Sep low with no company news behind it, two peer/proxy reads pointing to rising vet-cost severity and a softer puppy funnel, and a history of selling Q3 beats (-8.3% in Nov 2025). The findings sum to +0.5 and the scaled number is +0.27 (p_up 51 x abs 13.5). The two agree in sign; neither is a real lean.
bar: Company Q3 2026 guide from the Q2 call transcript (5 Aug 2026): total revenue $399-405M, subscription revenue $284-287M, total adjusted operating income (AOI) $44-47M, at a 0.71 USD/CAD rate; FY2026 revenue $1.584-1.601B (maintained), AOI $176-184M (narrowed). https://s29.q4cdn.com/621138337/files/doc_financials/2026/q2/Trupanion-Q2-2026-Earnings-Call-Transcript.pdf . Street revenue consensus about $402.5M (Benzinga https://www.benzinga.com/quote/TRUP/earnings-forecasts), inside the guide. EPS consensus is disputed across sources ($0.16 GAAP at Earnings Whispers vs $0.84 'non-GAAP' at Benzinga), so EPS is NOT used as the bar. print_vs_bar_pct is my AOI estimate (~$47M) against the $45.5M guide midpoint.
positioning_check: Short interest 3,676,788 shares at the 15 Oct 2026 settlement, about 8.4% of shares outstanding, 9.31 days to cover. That is down from 4,059,198 on 15 Sep, so shorts covered about 380k shares into the rally (equibles, https://equibles.com/stocks/trup/shortinterest). Fintel showed 11.85% of float and 18.99 days to cover as of 8 Sep 2026 (https://fintel.io/s/us/TRUP). This is a moderately crowded short that has been covering. The option chain is unusable: ATM spread is 103% of mid, so there is no skew and no implied move. ATM IV of 130.7% on the 20 Nov expiry and a put/call open-interest ratio of 0.32 lean call-heavy but are not reliable. Tape: +30.7% over 20 days and +11.8% over 5 days. A Form 4 sale at $22.92 on 28 Sep 2026 shows the stock is about 47% off its late-September low into the print. There has been no 8-K since 5 Aug 2026 (EDGAR atom feed).

findings.finding: Q2 2026 printed above the top of both guide ranges: revenue $392.9M vs a $386-392M guide, AOI $43.3M vs $40-43M. The Q3 AOI guide of $44-47M implies only ~11% growth, against 24% in Q2 and 27% in H1. The FY AOI guide was narrowed to $176-184M rather than raised. A third straight top-of-range AOI print (~$47M+) plus an FY raise is the likely setup.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 beat plus the $100M buyback: +15.46%. Q1 2026 beat (EPS $0.11 vs $0.07): +1.42%. Q3 2025 revenue beat ($366.9M vs $362.3M) with an adjusted-profit miss on higher acquisition spend: -8.34%. The Feb 2026 FY-guide print: -13.01%. Beats alone have not been reliably bought; guidance direction decides.
findings.why_not_priced: Probably partly priced. The stock has rallied ~47% off the 28 Sep low with no company news, which is what a market already expecting a beat looks like. What is not visible is the size of the FY AOI raise. A guide that implies H2 growth roughly half of H1's leaves room the Street can only update on the release.
findings.independence: Q2 guide-vs-actual from the Q1 outlook (Q2 revenue guide $386-392M, AOI $40-43M), reported by Quartr: https://quartr.com/events/trupanion-trup-q1-2026_3YSn9QbD . Same company, different document.

findings.finding: The California Department of Insurance approved a 28.1% average rate increase for American Pet Insurance Company, Trupanion's California underwriter. It affects 94,326 policyholders (about 8% of 1.125M subscription pets) at renewals after 19 July 2026, and some policies rise more than 70%. Q3 subscription ARPU gets a partial-quarter lift; the retention metric (98.37% TTM in Q2) carries the churn risk.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: ARPU growth of +9% in Q2 2026 (pricing that tracks vet inflation) came with the +15.46% Q2 reaction. Retention has not surprised in either direction in the sourced history.
findings.why_not_priced: It was approved before the 5 Aug guide, so the ARPU effect sits inside the subscription revenue guide ($284-287M). What is unpriced is the retention reaction: a visible dip in monthly retention below 98.3% would show the cost.
findings.independence: Insurify reports a 33% hike for ~97,000 California policies effective the same date (https://insurify.com/pet-insurance/news/trupanion-california-rate-hike). That is the same regulatory action with a conflicting figure, so it is not independent.

findings.finding: Lemonade's Q3 2026 shareholder letter (filed with the SEC on 4 Nov 2026 after the close, after Trupanion last spoke) shows the pet gross loss ratio at 75%, up from 74% in Q2 2026 and 69% in Q3 2025. Industry claim severity was still rising through Q3. Trupanion's own Q2 value proposition was 70.2% vs 71.1% a year earlier.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Trupanion's value proposition improved 90bp y/y in Q2 and the stock rose 15.46%. In Q3 2025 higher acquisition costs and investment drove an adjusted-profit miss and an -8.34% reaction. There is no sourced instance of the stock trading on a peer loss ratio.
findings.why_not_priced: It was released less than one session before the print, and Lemonade's pet book is a different, fast-growing (+53% IFP) book, so the read-through is easy to dismiss. If the market had taken it as a read-through, TRUP would have weakened on 5 Nov rather than extending a +11.8% 5-day run.
findings.independence: Proxy, not a Trupanion number. Trupanion's CEO said on 5 Aug that vet inflation is 'still at the double-digit level' (same Q2 transcript as finding 1). Piper's 26 Aug downgrade cited costlier claims from an ageing pet base: https://www.webull.ca/news-detail/15470237085942784

findings.finding: IDEXX's Q3 2026 call (2 Nov 2026) put US same-store clinical visits at about -1.8%, worse than Q2's -1.3%, and said puppy and kitten adoption stays muted. This is the 'shrinking puppy vet-visit funnel' Piper used to downgrade TRUP on 26 Aug, and it bears on Trupanion's vet-referral gross pet adds (Q2 net adds of 18,800, +39% y/y).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Piper downgrade on this thesis moved the stock about -6% on 26 Aug 2026. On the Q2 print, net adds accelerated despite the industry visit decline the company itself acknowledged, and the stock rose 15.46%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: Trupanion acknowledged the 'downturn in new visits' on 5 Aug and guided with it. What is new is that Q3 visits got worse, not better. Fewer visits also lower claim frequency, which offsets part of it.
findings.independence: Proxy. Piper's downgrade rationale is the same thesis from a different source: https://www.webull.ca/news-detail/15470237085942784 . Trupanion's own Q2 remark is in the transcript cited in finding 1.

findings.finding: On 5 Aug Trupanion authorised a $100M opportunistic buyback (no expiry), backed by a $44M extraordinary dividend from APIC and 'just under $100 million of available operating cash'. The Q2 10-Q shows zero repurchases in H1. The stock then traded as low as $22.92 (Form 4, 28 Sep). The Q3 release or 10-Q is the first disclosure of whether and how much was bought near the lows; $100M is about 7% of today's ~$1.48B market cap.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The buyback authorisation was announced with Q2 and the stock rose 15.46%. Execution has never been disclosed before.
findings.why_not_priced: Execution is unknown until the filing. BofA asked on the call whether the program would actually be used, and the CFO would not commit to its pace against pet acquisition spend. A disclosed $20-40M bought near $23-26 would be news. The October rally and the ~380k-share short reduction are consistent with a steady buyer but do not prove one.
findings.independence: Q2 10-Q shows no repurchases in H1 2026: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001371285/000137128526000172/trup-20260630.htm . The execution itself is an inference.

findings.finding: The Q3 guide assumed a 0.71 USD/CAD rate. The Canadian dollar traded at about 0.714 on 5 Aug, 0.725 on 20 Aug and 0.721 on 11 Sep, so a Q3 average near 0.72 gives a small FX tailwind to reported revenue: roughly 1.4% on the CAD-denominated book, about $1M.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No sourced instance of the stock trading on FX.
findings.why_not_priced: Too small for anyone to model. Claims are also paid in CAD, so the effect on AOI is mostly offset.
findings.independence: YCharts CAD/USD 0.7213 on 11 Sep 2026: https://ycharts.com/indicators/canadian_dollar_to_us_dollar_exchange_rate . The 0.71 assumption is in the Q2 transcript.

findings.finding: The stock rose about 47% from $22.92 (28 Sep Form 4) to $33.74 at the seal, +30.7% in 20 days and +11.8% in 5. EDGAR shows no 8-K since 5 Aug, and no upgrade was found. The bar going into the print has risen with the price, on a name whose last Q3 print fell 8.3% on a revenue beat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Nov 2025 (Q3): -8.34% on a revenue beat with a profitability miss. Aug 2026: +15.46% after the stock had been weak into the print.
findings.why_not_priced: The run-up itself is in the price by definition. The open question is whether it set an above-guide whisper the print has to clear. With no chain and no skew there is no market statement of that bar. Short covering of 380k shares (Sep 15 to Oct 15) means less squeeze fuel is left than in September.
findings.independence: Short-interest decline: https://equibles.com/stocks/trup/shortinterest . The run-up is in the sealed baseline.

outside_window.finding: Trupanion and Pets Best will end their relationship after Q3 2028 (disclosed 5 Aug 2026); the other-business segment ($116.2M revenue, 1.6% AOI margin in Q2) winds down then.
The new digital insurance product is to launch around mid-2027 (midpoint of the current strategic plan), per the Q2 call.

Barchart and StockStory 'why TRUP is up/sliding' pages for Sep-Nov 2026: page bodies empty, cause not established

baseline_tension: There is no skew to agree with. The +30.7% 20-day run-up says the market has already moved toward a good print, so my mildly positive guidance finding goes with the run-up, which is why it is sized small; the negatives are small proxies against a moderately crowded but covering short.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a verified fact is not a predicted reaction): the guide-conservatism finding went from +1.5 to +1.0, because Q3 2025 and Q1 2026 beats were sold or barely bought.
Rule 6 (inside the guide): the California rate increase went from +0.3 to +0.2, because it was approved before the guide was set.
Rule 5 (a proxy is small): Lemonade went from -0.7 to -0.5 and IDEXX from -0.4 to -0.2 (the company had already acknowledged the visit decline); both are kept and filed.
Rule 5 (an absence of explanation is worth 0) and rule 7 (positioning): the unexplained run-up finding went from -1.0 to -0.5. It is kept because the run-up and the short covering are sourced facts.
Rule 5 (an inference is small): the buyback execution inference went from +0.5 to +0.4.
abs_move_pct (13.5) and p_up (51) are unchanged, so expected_move_pct stays 0.27.
